bodyMarkdown:
## Average Salary Perth: From Hourly to Annual

If you're looking up the **average salary perth**, you're likely comparing job offers or planning your finances. This article shows you how to convert your hourly rate to annual pay, estimate tax and super, and understand where the numbers come from. We use the standard 38-hour week as a base, but you can adjust for your own hours.

### The Basic Conversion Formula

The core calculation is simple: **annual gross pay = hourly rate × hours per week × 52**. For a full-time employee working 38 hours each week, that becomes:

**Annual = hourly × 38 × 52**

For example, at the National Minimum Wage of $26.44 per hour (from 1 July 2026, the annual gross would be $26.44 × 38 × 52 = $51,993.72. If you work fewer hours, use your actual weekly hours instead of 38. The formula assumes the same rate every week with no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, allowances, or salary sacrifice. It's a starting point for an estimate, not a determination of your pay.

### National Minimum Wage, Awards, and Casual Loading

The Fair Work Commission sets the National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026: $26.44 per hour for 38 hours, and casual workers get 25% loading on top, making the casual rate $33.05 per hour. If you are a casual, you should use the [the timesheet (home page) and check the casual loading box. Do not type a rate that already includes casual loading.

Award rates may be higher than the minimum. Many industries have their own pay guides for your industry.

### Fortnightly Pay

Fortnightly pay is simply weekly pay times two. For a 38-hour week at $26.44 per hour, weekly is $1,004.90, so fortnightly is $2,009.80 before tax. Super is paid on top of ordinary earnings, not included in that amount.

### Tax and Medicare

Once you have your annual gross, you can estimate tax using the 2026–27 resident tax scale:

- Nil tax on the first $18,200
- 15% on income from $18,201 to $45,000
- 30% on income from $45,001 to $135,000
- 37% on income from $135,001 to $190,000
- 45% on income above $190,000

Medicare levy is generally 2% of taxable income. For the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds are used here because the 2026–27 thresholds were not confirmed. This is an estimate only. For a more detailed calculation, see the [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) page.

### Superannuation

Super guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top of your salary. It stops at the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year. For example, if your annual ordinary earnings are $60,000, your employer must contribute $7,200 in super. This is not deducted from your pay; it's additional. Learn more on the [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) page.

### Average Salary Perth Context

When you search for the **average salary perth**, you might see figures from the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) for Western Australia. The ABS reports national full-time adult ordinary time earnings of $2,083.70 per week (May 2026), which equates to about $108,352 per year. For all employees (including part-time), the average is $1,579.20 per week, or $82,118 per year. These are national averages, not a job median for Perth. Perth's average may differ due to industry mix and cost of living. For a specific role, check industry pay guides or the [job pay](/topics/job-pay) page.

### Using the Timesheet and Other Tools

The [the timesheet](/) on this site lets you enter your base hourly rate and optionally add 25% casual loading. It then shows your annual, fortnightly, and weekly gross pay, along with estimated tax and super. Remember: the timesheet assumes 38 hours per week unless you change it. For award rates, refer to the [pay guides](/blog) and [reference tables](/data).

### Summary

Converting your hourly rate to annual pay is straightforward: multiply by hours per week and 52. Use the 38-hour week as a standard, but adjust for your actual hours. Tax and Medicare are estimated based on 2026–27 rates, and super is 12% on top. The **average salary perth** is a useful benchmark, but always check your specific award or agreement. This site provides estimates, not determinations.

For more details, see the [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) page or the [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) guide.
